contexts.text: Believing that the life of Hell can be transcribed into that of Heaven... AC 10749. HH 527:2.
Infernal love cannot be transcribed into heavenly love.
Something of the husband is constantly being transcribed into the wife, and is inscribed on her.
Woman was created from man by a transcription of his wisdom...
Are transcribed into the deliciousnesses in our bosoms.
That love (of himself) has been transcribed into the wife.
That the transcription of the good of one into another is impossible. Explained. CL 525:4. (Compare BE 111.)
Imputation, if it means such a transcription, is a silly word. Explained.
This life cannot be transcribed into any man, except together with love and wisdom.
Add only... transcription, and you will be a vicarious pope.
Beware of the transcription of the imputation of the former Church into that of the New.
Thus has good, or evil, transcribed itself into the body.
